_note: Per-4KB-page latency as lognormal(median, p99) in microseconds. 'measured' = from a published benchmark (see sources); 'derived' = inferred from measured neighbours; 'estimate' = general knowledge.

zram.source: LZ4 >= 3 GB/s → ~1 µs/page + fault handling; no trustworthy direct measurement

emmc.source: SanDisk DF4032 CDM 4K read 9.9 MB/s → 414 µs — notebookcheck.net/SanDisk-DF4032-Benchmarked.703684.0.html; p99 and writes estimated

nvme.source: Samsung 970 EVO Plus RND4K Q1T1 49.5 MB/s → 83 µs — ssd-tester.com/samsung_970_evo_plus_1tb.html

phone_usb2.source: Android USB tether ping 0.5–1 ms (Tom's HW forum, audio-share#16) + 4 KB at 35 MB/s + TCP/userspace

phone_usb3.source: NCM gadget >2 Gbps (lore.kernel.org 2020-09); stack and phone wakeups dominate latency

phone_usb3_ffs.source: USRP B210 USB3 min RTT 160 µs; Samsung T7 RND4K Q1T1 → 190 µs; FX3 200–600 µs; xHCI IMOD 40 µs
